currentLines.speaker: Zenny
currentLines.text: [deadpan] OK, Fuzzby, calm down. It’s not that funny.
currentLines.previousText: Keen’s miss has just landed; Zenny absorbs the hit.
currentLines.dramaticIntention: Keep the room calm and undercut the chaos without giving Keen a bigger reaction.
currentLines.subtext: I am not indulging this mess.
currentLines.cadenceAndBreath: Still, low, almost matter-of-fact; tiny pause before the last clause.
currentLines.timingAndBody: Seated, nearly motionless; one-eye twitch, then a small reset breath.

currentLines.speaker: Keen
currentLines.previousText: Zenny’s flat warning has landed; Keen realizes the prank is wrong-footed.
currentLines.dramaticIntention: Register the failure before it fully hits him.
currentLines.cadenceAndBreath: Cut off and small, with a trapped intake on the dash.
currentLines.timingAndBody: Already ducking low; the word comes from behind the shame.

currentLines.speaker: Keen
currentLines.previousText: The catapult rebounds and smacks his tail.
currentLines.dramaticIntention: React instantly to the rebound hit and sell the physical surprise.
currentLines.timingAndBody: A tiny recoil/duck; the pain reads through the body first.

currentLines.speaker: Fuzzby
currentLines.previousText: The chain reaction has settled; Fuzzby has become the witness.
currentLines.dramaticIntention: Turn the wreck into approving witness energy.
currentLines.subtext: This disaster is entertaining enough to praise.
currentLines.cadenceAndBreath: Light, easy, almost pleased with the contraption’s violence.
currentLines.timingAndBody: Wakes up into the moment; amused lean toward the honeycomb.

currentLines.speaker: Keen
currentLines.previousText: Fuzzby’s praise lands; Keen tries to answer without looking up.
currentLines.dramaticIntention: Try to salvage a shred of dignity after obvious failure.
currentLines.subtext: Please let this count as close enough.
currentLines.cadenceAndBreath: A small resigned exhale, then a thin attempt at self-justification.
currentLines.timingAndBody: Still hidden/withdrawn; the line comes from the floor, not the chest.
